signature: DOUBLE PRECISION FUNCTION DLANSF( NORM, TRANSR, UPLO, N, A, WORK )

params.name: norm
params.reference: Specifies the value to be returned in DLANSF as described above.

params.name: transr
uplo
N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$. When $N = 0$, DLANSF is set to zero.

params.name: a
params.reference: On entry, the upper (if `UPLO = 'U'`) or lower (if `UPLO = 'L'`) part of the symmetric matrix A stored in RFP format. See the "Notes" below for more details. Unchanged on exit.

params.name: WORK
params.reference: where $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge N$ when `NORM = 'I'` or '1' or 'O'; otherwise, `WORK` is not referenced.

notes: no derivable minimum length for workspace WORK
